tagline: Pioneer in industrial automation and digital factory solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The Application Technology segment is the primary growth and innovation driver, particularly through smart digital solutions such as EcoScreen Equipment Analytics, positioning Dürr at the forefront of industrial digitalization.

kpis.name: Application Technology Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from application technologies such as paint spraying, adhesive application, and sealing systems.
kpis.description: This segment includes key innovations such as digital solutions for real-time analysis of painting processes, with an operating EBIT of €68.2 million in 2018.
kpis.signal: Key segment generating approximately 17% of total revenue

kpis.name: Net Bookings
kpis.explanation: Total value of new orders received during the year.
kpis.description: Orders reached a record level of €3.93 billion in 2018, reflecting strong demand in the automotive and industrial sectors.

kpis.name: Order Backlog
kpis.explanation: Value of orders already received but not yet delivered.
kpis.description: An increasing order backlog of €2.58 billion ensures strong visibility into revenues for the coming years.
kpis.signal: Well-filled backlog, visibility into future revenues

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company during the year.
kpis.description: Revenue increased to €3.87 billion in 2018, driven by strong demand in key segments, with 56% coming from the automotive sector.

kpis.name: EBIT Margin
kpis.description: EBIT margin declined to 6.0% in 2018, impacted by exceptional charges of €41.4 million and investments in digital transformation, but underlying EBIT margin excluding exceptional items was 7.1%.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after necessary investments (operating cash flow minus capital expenditures).
kpis.description: FCF increased significantly to €78.4 million in 2018 (+448% vs 2017), up from €14.3 million, despite moderate capex and operational challenges.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.description: Headcount increased to 16,312 employees (+8.9%) in 2018, primarily to strengthen digital and innovation capabilities, with 50% of staff located internationally.

kpis.name: Operating Result (EBIT)
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before interest and taxes.
kpis.description: EBIT decreased to €233.5 million in 2018 due to exceptional charges of €41.4 million related to FOCUS 2.0 optimization and acquisitions. Excluding exceptional items, EBIT was €274.9 million (-3.1%).
kpis.signal: Decline driven by optimization-related exceptional charges

kpis.name: Digital Factory Initiatives
kpis.explanation: Launch of Digital Factories starting in early 2018 to accelerate software development with smart applications.
kpis.description: Since 2018, Dürr has launched Digital Factories to accelerate agile development of smart applications such as EcoScreen Equipment Analytics with Streaming-Analytics-Technology for real-time analysis of painting processes.

kpis.name: ADAMOS IIoT Platform
kpis.explanation: Industrial Internet of Things platform co-developed with partners to connect machines and analyze data in real time.
kpis.description: ADAMOS is a key platform co-established with partners to connect machines and analyze data in real time. Dürr positions itself as a leader in smart applications for digital production processes.

kpis.name: HOMAG Group Performance
kpis.explanation: The HOMAG Group (Woodworking Machinery and Systems) achieved a record EBIT of €86.2 million in 2018 despite supply chain constraints.
kpis.description: HOMAG Group generated a record EBIT of €86.2 million in 2018 (after purchase price allocation) on revenue of €1,298.3 million, and is deploying a new flexible production system for the complete furniture production line market.
kpis.signal: Record performance despite supply chain challenges

risks.title: Dependence on automotive demand
risks.score_rationale: The risk is repeatedly mentioned in the report, with strong language on the 'slowness of order intake' and the impact of customer investment decisions. It is central to Supervisory Board discussions and directly affects core operations. Trend stable.

risks.title: Increased competition in automation
risks.score_rationale: Although not explicitly stated, Dürr's strategic positioning as a production technology provider (vs. parts supplier) implies intense technological competition. The language emphasizes resilience and efficiency, indicating high competitive pressure. Trend stable.

risks.title: Growing regulation on sustainability
risks.score_rationale: The report mentions climate strategy, CO₂ emissions (Scopes 1 and 2), and the CSRD directive multiple times. Language intensity is moderate but increasing, reflecting growing regulatory pressure. Trend rising.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of industrial systems
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly cited in Audit Committee reports on IT security and governance. The language is technical and serious, indicating critical exposure. Trend stable.

risks.title: Dependence on critical suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Not directly mentioned, but implied within the context of a complex industrial supply chain. Risk is moderate as mitigated by operational risk management. Trend stable.

risks.title: Integration of artificial intelligence
risks.score_rationale: AI is mentioned as a strategic priority by the Supervisory Board and Technology Council. The language is forward-looking, indicating adoption or implementation risk. Trend rising.

risks.title: Transformation in the wood industry
risks.score_rationale: The report notes weak demand in the furniture industry and its impact on order intake. Language is concerned but not alarmist. Trend stable.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and tariffs
risks.score_rationale: U.S. tariff announcements are cited as a factor of trade turbulence directly impacting customer investment behavior. Language is strong and central among risks. Trend rising.

ai_positioning.summary: Dürr integrates artificial intelligence and data analytics into its industrial processes through solutions such as EcoScreen Equipment Analytics. The company positions itself as a technology integrator combining hardware and intelligent software for the digitalization of production processes.
evidence: Launch of the Smart EcoScreen Equipment Analytics application with Streaming-Analytics for real-time analysis of painting processes
Establishment of Digital Factories starting in early 2018 to accelerate agile software innovation
Co-development and launch of the ADAMOS IIoT platform for industrial connectivity and data analytics
